reason: EUR 5,000 minimum for three months with no meetings promised is what I'd pay a junior SDR plus Lemlist, and I've already seen I can scrape lists and send sequences myself for a fraction of that. Plus two weeks of profile approvals and handing over my customer list is exactly the homework my team doesn't have time for.
objection: I pay EUR 1,500 a month while my people still have to approve the ICP, the target list and every reply, and after 60 days I might still have zero meetings to show for it.
would_change_my_mind: A one-country pilot for the market we're entering next year, priced per qualified meeting or with part of the fee refunded if no meetings come in 60 days, and with the approval steps cut down to one short call.
